label: CapRel system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a fused CapRel toxin-antitoxin locus encoding an N-terminal toxSAS toxin domain and a C-terminal antitoxin sensor domain that together can restrict bacteriophage propagation.
observations: CapRel branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual capRel genes, standalone CapRel proteins, toxSAS domains, C-terminal CapRel antitoxin domains, phage trigger proteins such as major capsid protein or Gp54, tRNA pyrophosphorylation or translation blockade as processes, DefenseFinder/PADLOC rows naming one predicted locus, generic toxin-antitoxin systems, and other phage defense systems.
